Pritam S. Warghade is a Lead / Senior Piping Engineer with 25+ years of global EPC and EPCM experience across nuclear, oil and gas, offshore, refinery, petrochemical, chemical, industrial, utility and brownfield projects. Core tools include AVEVA E3D, PDMS, SP3D, PDS, Navisworks, SmartPlant Review, LFM and AutoCAD. Public recruiter contact: +91 9172645866, warghade2012@gmail.com.
